verdict: No robust trained entry or continuation model. Unscored ETH far/opposite targets are positive exploratory baselines, but absolute-net confidence intervals include zero and matched tests fail multiplicity and p<0.01 gates.

config.authorized: Owner 2026-10-31: BTC/ETH research and fitting; fixed 0.7% initial stop, near Monday edge, expire before next NY Monday
config.fee_source: OKX account Lv1 read 2026-10-23; fees per fill
config.episode: Adjacent 15m bars spanning exact 1.618 merge; one non-hit 15m bar rearms. First 5m touch in each episode; only favorable resting-limit approaches executable.
config.control: Random completed 5m closes, same coin/NY week/direction/pre-entry relative-ATR log2 quarter bucket; same percentage barriers and expiry. Market control pays taker entry; signal resting limit pays maker. No outcome resampling.
config.model: Median imputation, standard scaling, L2 logistic regression C=1; no search. Weight inverse coin-week counts, equal aggregate coin weight. Previous quarter sigmoid calibration, per coin when n>=30 and both classes else pooled.
config.evaluation: Expanding training; quarters from 2025Q1, previous quarter calibration, complete NY weeks stay together. Purge label weeks crossing each split. One position per coin at submission time. No compounded-account claims.
config.entry_gate: p(target-before-stop-or-expiry) greater than fee-adjusted target/stop break-even probability; timeout treated as failure for labels, actual native timeout PnL for evaluation.
config.continuation: At completed 5m close containing first near-target hit, only if far-position remains open. Fixed original stop. Compare native close-now versus cached farther target, separately for far/opposite1618; same rolling model recipe.
config.inference: NY week cluster bootstrap 2000 draws; paired weekly sign-flip 10000 draws; descriptive and exploratory, not untouched confirmatory history.

validation.numeric_warnings: Local sklearn matmul RuntimeWarnings retained in logs; all frozen model/calibrator outputs checked against einsum/elementwise calculations, finite coefficients and first-order gradients.
validation.continuation_scope: Conditional independent opportunity study after near-touch completed close; not an integrated single-position entry-plus-continuation account strategy. Calibrated model folds lacking history are explicitly skipped.
